name: save-button

frames.best_why: The collection picker is open below a Saved button, showing swatches, counts and the current choice.

tagline: Saves a card and shows a strip for picking its collection.
summary: A bookmark button for a content card. Saving turns it dark and drops a strip naming the collection; from there you can move the item or create a new collection.
appearance: A white card holds a mountain photo above a title and location, with a small rounded Save pill on the right. Saved, the pill darkens; beneath it a narrow white strip and then a taller picker panel list collections with coloured squares and counts.
behaviour: Clicking Save fills the bookmark, flips the label to Saved and reveals a strip naming the collection. Change opens a taller list where a click moves the item, and the strip returns showing the new collection before timing out.
demo_content: Mountain photo card 'Cabane du Mont Fort, Verbier · 2,457 m' with four collection names.
search_phrases: add item to a folder menu
little save pill on a card
bookmark that shows where it was saved
use_when: A card or article can be saved into several named collections and the chosen one should stay visible.
avoid_when: The panel is absolutely positioned below the button, so an overflow-hidden card will cut it off.
customise: Collections, default collection, default saved state and save/move/remove callbacks are props; the swatch palette and strip timeout live in the file.
weight_why: One button and a small panel; motion runs only while the strip opens or swaps.

a11y.note: Focus moves into the picker and back, Escape closes it, and status changes are announced live.

polish_why: Neat layered states and tidy spacing; the panel is compact and readable.
title: Save Button
